mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.2% signals a tightening labor market, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending wage inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.2.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115 signals strengthening supply chains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 115 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals broadening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 370000.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 5.5% signals monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during late-cycle regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of late-cycle instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5) and high payroll employment (PAYEMS > 138000) signals a labor market at full capacity, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when both UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS > 138000.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% signals strong aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but this effect is muted during monetary tightening regimes.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 > 3% are not significantly higher than baseline during non-tightening regimes (t-test p > 0.05).
